section: Sec. 42-181(a)(2) (3,500 sq ft per single-family lot in the city); Sec. 42-185(a) (20 ft width); Sec. 42-1 (a single-family lot holds up to 2 units). No use zoning, no FAR, no lot coverage cap and no height cap on a standard lot. Smaller lots, 3-8 unit and courtyard options are in zoning_steps.json

Sec. 42-181(a)(1) (5,000 sq ft per single-family lot in the extraterritorial jurisdiction); Sec. 42-185(a) (20 ft width). No FAR, coverage or height cap in Chapter 42. Match value comes from the ETJ layer, not the city limit layer (see notes.md)
